description: EE1: Transform into a forme-changed target, whose forme ability then does nothing. Start: Torkoal's Drought sets sun and Castform (Forecast) becomes Castform-Sunny. The turn: Ditto (Limber; Choice Scarf and Speed SP so that it never ties with Castform) transforms into it first (species Castform-Sunny, Fire type, Forecast); Torkoal's Rain Dance then turns the real Castform Rainy, but Forecast returns at once for a transformed Pokemon (`pokemon.transformed`), so Ditto stays Castform-Sunny.
